caption: The drawing features a single object: a bucket with a rounded handle resting on its rim. The bucket is an irregular cylindrical shape, appearing somewhat squashed and aged, with a surface showing signs of wear and cracking. The main color is a muted, tan-brown, with darker shading used to represent folds and texture. Around the upper-middle section, a dark blue oval band with a red border wraps around the bucket, displaying the white, partially visible letters "Consti" in a serif font. The bucket casts a soft shadow to the left and below, setting it against a plain, pale beige background that has no additional objects or patterns.
title: Leather Fire Bucket
